# {{PROJECT_NAME}}

> A modern, AI-optimized full-stack web application built on the Vibe-Stack architecture.

## Architecture Overview
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, React 19, TypeScript)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 with modern theme tokens and glassmorphism styling
- **Components**: Radix UI primitives & Lucide Icons
{{LLMS_DATABASE_OVERVIEW}}
- **AI Context Layer**: Pre-tuned context engines (.cursorrules, AGENTS.md, llms.txt)

## Key Directories & File Roles
- `app/`: Next.js App Router root
  - `app/layout.tsx`: Root layout, fonts, dark mode class, global header/footer wrappers
  - `app/page.tsx`: Landing page & interactive showcase
  - `app/globals.css`: Tailwind v4 theme definitions and design tokens
  - `app/api/`: Edge and Node.js Route Handlers (JSON responses, standard HTTP status codes)
- `components/`: Modular, reusable UI components adhering to single-responsibility design
- `lib/`: Shared utilities, helpers, and client configurations
{{LLMS_LIB_FILES}}
- `types/`: Strongly-typed TypeScript interfaces and database schemas

{{LLMS_DATABASE_SCHEMA}}

## Coding Conventions for LLMs
1. **React Server Components (RSC) First**: Default all components in `app/` to Server Components. Only add `'use client'` when state, effects, or browser APIs are mandatory.
2. **Tailwind v4 Clean Classes**: Do not use legacy `@apply` hacks. Use direct utility classes and CSS theme variables.
3. **Strict TypeScript**: Avoid `any`. Type all props, API inputs, and database records.
4. **Environment Variables**: Access client variables via `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_*` and server secrets via `process.env.*`. Never expose service keys to the client.
5. **Clean Async & Error Handling**: Wrap data-fetching logic with proper fallback UI, loading skeletons, and error boundaries.

## Target Audience for this File
This file is parsed by LLMs (Claude, GPT-4, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, Gemini) to immediately understand the project anatomy and architectural decisions without scanning thousands of lines of boilerplate.
